      "band": "Unranked",

      "name": "kernel",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/kernel/mempool_options.h and src/kernel/mempool_removal_reason.* to delete unused options and the EXPIRY enum.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Edits to kernel headers strictly follow the removal of mempool expiry and do not target kernel library architecture or boundaries."
    },
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Labeled Mempool; removes time-based eviction and the entry_time multi-index from CTxMemPool.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Removing time-based expiry fixes an incentive-incompatible policy that drops mineable transactions and wastes network relay bandwidth. An analysis of over 938,000 expired transactions showed 92% were ultimately mined, making age-based eviction counterproductive while eliminating the maintenance cost of an O(log n) multi-index tree."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches test/functional/mempool_expiry.py and fuzz harnesses in response to mempool behavior changes.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Modifications to tests pinning mempool and wallet behavior belong to their respective functional areas rather than test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/init.cpp to handle the deprecated -mempoolexpiry configuration argument.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Retaining a deprecated command-line flag as a no-op warning in init.cpp is a peripheral consequence of the mempool policy change."
    },
    {
      "name": "validation",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Touches src/validation.cpp and headers to eliminate expiry removal handling.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "Changes passing through validation files purely follow mempool eviction changes without modifying consensus or chainstate validation."
    },

      "name": "wallet",
